name: Young Crocolisk Skins
summary: In Menethil Harbor, prominent tanner James Halloran needs fresh skins from young marsh crocolisks. Their cured hides are in demand across the sea, so steady hunting keeps his trade supplied. Bringing him the softer skins earns his trust and leads to more leatherworking chores.

sections.title: A Harbor's Export
sections.body: Menethil Harbor links the Eastern Kingdoms to distant continents, and its busy local economy draws on the surrounding marsh. James Halloran tans and cures hides from the region's abundant reptilian predators for trade across the sea. Merchants and ships carry his leather goods to distant ports, keeping pressure on his workshop to maintain a steady supply.

sections.title: Hunting the Young Marsh Lurkers
sections.body: Einar brings Halloran regular hauls of mature hides, but those are too firm for some luxury goods. Halloran relies on passing travelers to fill the shortage of softer leather by hunting young crocolisks in the shallow bogs just outside Menethil's palisades. The skins must stay intact for Halloran's careful curing process.

faq.answer: James Halloran is a prominent tanner in Menethil Harbor. His cured crocolisk skins are known across the world and shipped to foreign ports across the Great Sea.

faq.q: Why does Halloran need young crocolisk skins specifically?
faq.answer: Young crocolisks have softer, more pliable hides than adults. Their skins suit luxury goods and fine leatherwork that the stiffer adult hides cannot provide.
Einar is a local hunter stationed in the Wetlands who works with James Halloran. He regularly treks into the marsh to cull wild crocolisks and bring raw skins to the harbor workshop.

faq.q: Where are these young crocolisks found?
faq.answer: Young crocolisks live in the waterways, reeds, and marshy shallows around Menethil Harbor, just beyond the town gates and docks.

faq.q: What happens after bringing the skins to Halloran?
aliases: next quest after young crocolisk skins
faq.answer: Impressed by the hides' quality, Halloran asks for help with other chores around his tanning operation. He gives you the usual work of an apprentice to keep his workshop moving.

faq.q: Why is crocolisk leather valuable in Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Crocolisk leather is valuable in Menethil Harbor because merchants and sailors prize the exotic, waterproof marsh hides cured by skilled artisans. The harbor connects Ironforge and Stormwind with overseas territories such as Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a hunter passing through the Wetlands, you can gather clean hides from native predators without spoiling the leather.
As an Alliance traveler, you help Menethil Harbor's maritime trade and supply lines flow across the Great Sea.
